module.description: The Icon renderer and its options.
module.name: icon

ui.guidance: Label names the icon for assistive technology. Empty is the common case and means decorative: the control around the icon already carries the name, so announcing the glyph as well is noise. A non-empty label is for an icon that is the only content of its control, where nothing else names it. An unregistered name renders nothing: the mistake stays visible where it was made, without an outage.
ui.name: icon
ui.summary: Renders one named glyph from the typed icon registry.
